description: Finds keyword ideas from seed terms with search volume, keyword difficulty, intent and the strength of the domains in the top 10 results, so a low difficulty score with strong domains ranking is visible. Use it for keyword research in one market. It spends from the user's own DataForSEO account inside the extension, within the monthly cap set there; a call over the cap is refused with an error saying so, and a cached answer from the last 7 days costs nothing. The agent never sees the key. Returns rows of keyword, volume, difficulty, intent and top-10 domain strength; a null figure is unknown to DataForSEO, never zero.

language.description: The language code, such as "en" or "de". Defaults to the market's main language.

limit.description: The most ideas to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100. More ideas cost more.

location.description: The market to read, as a country name DataForSEO knows, such as "United States" or "United Kingdom". Defaults to the market set in the extension.

seeds.description: 1 to 20 seed terms the ideas grow from, such as ["trail running shoes"].

name: keyword_ideas
title: Keyword ideas
